axes_source: Read from data/brands/intercom.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #111111 and the canvas #F5F1EC; contrast from the ink #111111 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #111111; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #111111 reaches 16.79:1 on the canvas #F5F1EC, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
